note: うさひめ long-legged four-legged trot, facing RIGHT (native: 1); mirror horizontally for left. Diagonal leg pairs alternate (0 stride A, 1 passing, 2 stride B, 3 passing). Lowest outline row 30 every frame; row 31 empty. Walk in place (game moves the actor).

frames.name: walk_0
frames.desc: stride A (contact): near-front + far-hind reach forward, near-hind + far-front push back; all 4 feet on row 30

frames.name: walk_1
frames.desc: passing: body up 1px, far-hind + near-front lifted & swinging forward, the other diagonal pair supports (feet row 30)

frames.name: walk_2
frames.desc: stride B (contact): far-front + near-hind reach forward, the other pair pushes back; all 4 feet on row 30

frames.name: walk_3
frames.desc: passing: body up 1px, near-hind + far-front lifted & swinging forward, the other diagonal pair supports (feet row 30)
